description: §21.4 (S462 Q19) — m.scrml re-exports `{ hash, NotAThing }` from `scrml:crypto`; `scrml:crypto` exports `hash` but not `NotAThing`, so the named re-export fires E-IMPORT-004 at the re-export. The module exists, so E-IMPORT-006 does NOT fire.
rationale: §21.4: "A named re-export from a `scrml:` module SHALL be checked against that module's exports (E-IMPORT-004, reported at the re-export)." Before S462 a named re-export from a stdlib module was never checked and the re-exported name was `undefined` at run time.
